module_outcomes: basebenze ngendlela efanele ngabodwana nakanye nabanye njengamalungu eqoqo
bazihlele futhi bazilawule kanye nemisebenzi yabo ngendlela efanele nenobuqotho;
Bathole futhi baxazulule izinkinga kanye nokuthatha izinqumo ngokusebenzisa ukucabanga okwakhayo nokujulile;
baqoqe, bahlaziye, bahlele futhi bahlole ulwazi ngendlela ejulile;
baxhumane ngendela efanele besebenzisa izindlela ezibonakalayo, ezingokwemifanekiso kanye/noma zamakhono olimi;
basebenzise isayensi kanye nobuchwepheshe ngendlela efanele nejulile bekhombisa ukuhlonipha imvelo kanye nempilo yabanye abantu; nokuthi
bakhombise ukuqonda umhlaba njengeqoqo lezinhlelo ezihlobene ngokwamukela ukuthi izimo zokuxazululwa kwezinkinga azizihambeli
consultation_times: Uhlelo lwezikhathi zokubonisana luyokwaziswa ngesonto lokuqala lezifundo bese lunanyathiselwa nasemnyango womfundisi.
module_purpose: Isigaba 1 semojuli sinikeza umfundi isingeniso kanye nohlaka lwemithetho ebalulekile kanye neminye imikhakha yesifundo sezilwane. Isigaba 2 sinikeza umfundi isingeniso kanye nohlaka lwemithetho ebalulekile yesifundo sendalo kanye nemvelo, kugcizelelwa esilwaneni kanye nemvelo esikuyo.
